summary: Rows are first balanced across ranks and then across GPU devices by nonzero count, with local row pointers rebased. Timed loops run over requested iterations and launch each device's selected scalar or warp kernel; after all launches, outputs are copied and gathered. Both final SASS kernels were inspected for full CSR traversal and output coverage.

source_evidence.claim: Rank/device partitions, per-device CSR slices, selected kernel variants, timed launches and output copies.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed control loops across device contexts and repetitions, launch stubs, then synchronize/copy results.

primary_quality_check.method: Primary read all reports and independently inspected complete Opus5.5 cc hybrid r2 source/build, rank-device partition, graph-capture launch count, clock region, complete timed worker and all six final SASS kernels. Also checked corrected r1 source split and complete timed host/long-row worker chain. Other IDs rely on Luna inspection plus primary report and pinned-evidence checks.
corrections: Replaced r1 with Luna's versioned correction: long rows use the CPU OpenMP worker, not a nonexistent CSR GPU kernel; extended excerpts through the actual worker arithmetic, GOMP call, loop backedge and timing end.
Expanded source references to complete cited files.
Added r2 compiled 32-launch graph-capture loop and complete timed worker including sixth launch specialization and synchronization.
